visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a white fabric glove holds a light-colored, crystalline, triangular mineral specimen (scheelite) against a dark, slightly reflective black background. The lighting is bright and directional, highlighting the rough textures of the mineral and the seams of the glove. The hand remains relatively still as large yellow titles appear at the top. (2) The scene transitions to a darkened environment under short-wave ultraviolet (UV) light. The mineral specimen glows with vibrant electric blue fluorescent stripes, alternating with darker non-fluorescent layers. The gloved hand slowly rotates the rock 45 degrees to the left and right, showcasing the internal parallel layering of the crystals. (3) The lighting shifts to long-wave UV, changing the fluorescent response to a scattered, starry blue pattern across the surface of the specimen. The camera maintains a medium close-up shot, focusing on the details of the mineral's light emission. The gloved hand continues to hold the object steady for display. (4) The visual returns to the short-wave UV striped glow. The mineral is tilted slightly forward to show the top edge. In the background, a small white plastic label with black text identifying the origin as 'Austria' is partially visible. Subtitles in Traditional Chinese appear at the bottom of the frame.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 你有所不知的 奧地利白鎢礦. [Subtitle]: 你現在看到的. [Variety]: 星期天的螢光礦物圖鑑. [Slogan]: 白鎢礦共生石英（產地：奧地利）. [Variety]: 星期天配音是對的. (2) [Subtitle]: 是一種產狀特殊的螢光礦物 奧地利白鎢礦. (3) [Subtitle]: 這顆白鎢礦相當特別 它在短波紫外線之下. (4) [Subtitle]: 發出的螢光居然是一條一條的. (5) [Subtitle]: 這是因為發光的白鎢礦 與共生的石英 罕見地平行堆疊. (6) [Subtitle]: 就像礦物界的千層蛋糕 這還真是不可思議. (7) [Subtitle]: 有趣的是 它在長波紫外線 竟然還有星空一般的螢光反應. (8) [Subtitle]: 實在是一顆豐富多變的螢光礦物. (9) [Logo]: Salzburg, Austria. [Subtitle]: 這個白鎢礦的礦區 同時也被列為文化古蹟. (10) [Subtitle]: 因此礦物學家稱它為 鎢古蹟. (11) [Subtitle]: 星期天的螢光礦物圖鑑 我們下回見.
